combinations.model: cultured mouse TG neurons, whole-cell recording of T-type current (IT)
combinations.evidence_quote: Knockdown of adipoR1 abrogated the adiponectin–induced IT response (increase 3.8 ± 1.5%, Fig. 2E)

combinations.model: cultured mouse TG neurons, whole-cell recording of T-type current (IT)
combinations.evidence_quote: pretreating TG neurons with the selective CK2 inhibitor CX-4945 abrogated the adiponectin-induced stimulatory effects in IT (increase 4.5 ± 0.8%, Figs. 3F and H)

combinations.model: cultured mouse TG neurons, whole-cell recording of T-type current (IT)
combinations.evidence_quote: Knockdown of CK2α completely abolished the adiponectin-induced increase in IT (Fig. 3J).

combinations.model: cultured mouse TG neurons, whole-cell recording of T-type current (IT)
combinations.evidence_quote: Knockdown of PKCβ1 in TG neurons abolished the adiponectin–induced increase in IT (increase -1.9% ± 1.5%, Fig. 5D).

combinations.readout: adiponectin-induced increase in action potential firing rate
combinations.model: cultured mouse TG neurons, whole-cell recording of T-type current (IT)
combinations.evidence_quote: Pretreatment of cells with TTA-P2 (3 μM) abrogated the adiponectin-induced increase in the rate of AP firing (Fig. 7I).

combinations.readout: adiponectin-induced increase in action potential firing rate
combinations.model: cultured mouse TG neurons, whole-cell recording of T-type current (IT)
combinations.evidence_quote: The adiponectin-mediated increase in the AP firing rate in TG neurons was completely eliminated by knockdown of Cav3.2 (Fig. 7K).

combinations.magnitude: adipoR1-siRNA prevented hypersensitivity; control siRNA had no effect
combinations.evidence_quote: AdipoR1-siRNA delivery into the TG prevented the mechanical hypersensitivity induced by adiponectin, while intra-TG delivery of control siRNA had no effects (Fig. 8B).
Similarly, preintra-TG injection of PKCβ1-siRNA eliminated adiponectin-induced hypersensitivity to mechanical pain (Fig. 8C).

combinations.magnitude: attenuated hypersensitivity (partial); TTA-P2 alone had no effect on threshold
combinations.evidence_quote: Delivery of TTA-P2 into the TG had no effect on the escape threshold; however, prior intra-TG injection of TTA-P2 attenuated adiponectin-induced mechanical hypersensitivity

combinations.magnitude: adipoR1-siRNA had no appreciably additive effect to Cav3.2-siRNA
combinations.model: trigeminal neuralgia, chronic constriction injury of infraorbital nerve (CCI-ION)
combinations.evidence_quote: Mechanical sensitivity in Cav3.2-siRNA-treated CCI-ION mice was measured following the injection of adipoR1-siRNA, and the results revealed that adipoR1-siRNA had no appreciably additive effect to Cav3.2 siRNA (Fig. 8H).
